text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower achieved splendid results 
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, one day, I visited a racetrack with 
Nishino Flower. That day happened to be an 
open turf day, and……

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—That meal earlier was delicious, wasn't 
it? The racetrack gourmet options were 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"We usually have boxed lunches, but eating 
outside every once in a while is fun too♪"
choice_data_list:
Thank you so much for always making this 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! I'm doing this simply 
because I love it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Such a gentle breeze is blowing here as 
well, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's a strange feeling. To be able to 
relax on the very turf where I always run 
my heart out.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a totally different place, 
but it's the exact same spot, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I don't usually notice it, but the turf 
is always so gentle and welcoming..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They raised me with such loving care. The 
racetrack is my beloved hometown too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"But I'm gonna grow even bigger! I'll 
definitely surpass you one day, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: That's something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Being small and inexperienced is proof 
that you can change so much from here on 
out, she said...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... please keep watching over me as I 
continue to change and grow♪
